$comment: The verification policy for stdlib/ (plato-388). Every gate, fixture and server reads this
file instead of carrying its own tier list, ceiling or recipe; stdlib/VERIFICATION.md
explains the policy and docs/verification-inventory.md lists the readers.
tiers: the subfolders of stdlib/, in dependency order. stdlib/tests is the law packet, not a tier.
checks: for each check, the tiers it covers. A tier absent from a check's list is exempt from it
(stdlib-377: `future` parses and type-checks but is neither linted, indexed nor converted to C#).
ratchets: the ceilings the PlatoTests ratchets enforce. A ceiling is lowered, never raised;
say why in the test's comment when one has to move up.
codegenRecipe: the C# writer flags of the shipping recipe (docs/plato-library-map.md).

lint.unit: lint findings of severity Error or Warning (Info excluded)
